action.objective: Develop the c1 bishop and preserve the verified d2d3 structure
action.rationale: Only d2d3 is commit_ready: exact depth-3 score 59, safety complete with no Black mate-in-one and no tactical refutation. It advances the center and PVs d5d4 Nb5. Remaining 1000 nodes cannot improve on this; f3d4 was only upper-bound. d2d3 is a solid, safe developing move.
